messages:
incidence-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INC-2026-4517: spike in routing errors for eu-west embedding requests -> fallbacks to gen-chat variant (5xxs). Trigger: rate of incompatible-schema errors > 20/min. Severity: P2
marcus (oncall): seeing it in the console now, +50% 500s for /v1/embeddings in eu-west, latency up as well. paging dinesh and carmen.
dinesh (eng-runtime): on it. initial hypothesis: alias 'stable-embed' was moved to a new anchor/version this morning which swapped to an instruct/gen-family checkpoint by mistake. routing table maps alias->anchor->variant; mismatch can route embedding traffic to a gen/chat variant that rejects the payload.
carmen (sre): customer impact? any customers on dedicated capacity?
marcus (oncall): CS ticket from Acme Search (eu) reporting search quality regressions + timeouts. 2 customer-facing errors logged. No Dedicated accounts affected so far, mostly hosted.
liz (product): Acme had hit a production search run, they reported ~8% query failures. We need a rollback if anchor change caused it.
dinesh (eng-runtime): pulling traces. here's a short snippet from the proxy logs: ```
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z ERROR route_eval: request_id=abc123 route=stable-embed anchor=anch_172 variant=chat-gen-6 reason=incompatible_io_schema: expected embedding input but got chat payload
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z WARN fallback: selected_variant=chat-gen-6, fallback_count=3
```
marcus (oncall): that matches the 500s. how did alias move? was there a canary rollout earlier?
dinesh (eng-runtime): I see an operator change at 09:05UTC: `routectl set-alias stable-embed -> anch_172` (was anch_120). anch_172 was intended for text-generation experiments; its default variant is chat-gen-6. Looks like the alias switch didn't pin the embedding-compatible variant.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: operator dinesh applied alias change at 2026-03-15T09:05:22Z (runbook: alias-rollout).
carmen (sre): mitigation options: 1) revert alias to anch_120 2) update routing policy to prefer variant type=embed for that alias 3) add a quick guard that rejects mismatched io schema at router rather than fallback to chat (prevents loop). We should choose the fastest safe option.
marcus (oncall): option 1 sounds fastest. can we roll back anchor in the control plane now?
dinesh (eng-runtime): I can revert alias immediately. Doing: `routectl set-alias stable-embed -> anch_120 --no-canary`
dinesh (eng-runtime): done. propagated to eu-west control plane in ~6s.
marcus (oncall): monitoring... 500s dropping?
carmen (sre): metrics: error rate from 52/min -> 6/min in 30s. latency back to baseline in eu-west. Acme reports retries succeeded.
liz (product): open a post-incident note for change controls. Was this human error during experiment rollout?
dinesh (eng-runtime): root cause: operator changed alias to an anchor whose default variant set did not include an embedding-compatible variant. Our alias->anchor promotion flow doesn't validate variant schema compatibility with common routes. I'll make a quick patch to the alias promotion validator.
marcus (oncall): paging note: I'll keep this thread open for the next 30m for watch. taking 1h followup to ensure canary policy adjusted. handoff to carmen in 30m.
carmen (sre): taking over watch. please add mitigation checklist to the incident doc.
customer-success-jane: Acme confirmed their immediate job completed after retry, thanked us. please include customer impact in the SLA report.
dinesh (eng-runtime): follow-up actions (short):
- add alias promotion validation: ensure target anchor exposes an embed-compatible variant for routes labeled `v1/embeddings` (PR raised: https://git.internal/r/redwood/route/PR-482)
- add router guard to avoid fallback to incompatible variants (issue #3124)
- docs: runbook update for alias promotions and canary checks
- retro: contact Acme CS and offer credits if SLA breached

marcus (oncall): assigning owners: dinesh -> validator PR, carmen -> router guard, liz -> customer comms.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4517 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
marcus (oncall): closing the paging alert for now but leaving thread open for after-action notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
